title_translated: PACT：验证扩散语言模型并行解码中所写内容的可靠性
summary_translated: 并行解码通过每次前向传播写出多个词元来加速掩码扩散语言模型。现有提交规则通过测试预测分布来选择这些词元。在采样过程中，被写出的词元是随机抽取的，而这些测试并未看到它们。我们发现，答案质量与实际写出的词元的可靠性密切相关。一个答案的对数概率可分解为这种可靠性以及每一步内部的依赖关系。我们提出PACT，一种无需训练的提交规则：先抽取词元，再认证将要写出的集合，并将每一步的位置间隔开。该认证在任意温度下均成立，且我们证明，任何具有相同保证的规则都无法提交更多位置。实验使用LLaDA和Dream系列的四个模型，以及HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K、MATH500和IFEval基准。PACT在更少前向传播次数下达到与已有提交规则相当的质量。间隔操作虽减少了每一步的位置数量，但通常降低了总成本，因为后续步骤能写出更多词元。在相同速度下，现有解码器比PACT更频繁地连续写出同一个词。结果表明，提交规则应认证其写出的内容。代码已发布于https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/PACT。

summary: Large language model (LLM) services face rapidly rising serving costs. To sustain free or affordable access for a broad user base, alternative monetization mechanisms are needed. Native advertising offers a promising approach, as it creates economic value by aligning user intent with merchant offerings. Yet how to integrate sponsored content naturally into LLM responses remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches primarily rely on prompt-level injection, multi-pass rewriting, or fine-tuning, which can compromise response quality or introduce additional computational costs. We propose AdSteer, a lightweight decoding-time advertising framework that adaptively adjusts token probabilities to integrate contextually appropriate advertisement into responses. AdSteer calibrates the strength and duration of advertising influence, making sponsored content a natural part of the response. Experiments on GEM-Bench across three application scenarios show that AdSteer achieves an average improvement of 14.1% in overall score over the strongest baselines and 22.5% fewer total tokens on average than rewrite-based methods. These results demonstrate that AdSteer provides an effective and practical solution for native advertising in LLMs.
title: AdSteer: Native Advertising in Large Language Model Generation
title_translated: AdSteer：大型语言模型生成中的原生广告
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）服务正面临迅速上升的部署成本。为维持广大用户群体的免费或低成本访问，需要替代性的变现机制。原生广告提供了一种有前景的方案，它通过将用户意图与商家推广内容对齐创造经济价值。然而，如何自然地将赞助内容融入LLM响应仍基本未被探索。现有方法主要依赖提示注入、多轮重写或微调，可能损害响应质量或引入额外计算开销。我们提出AdSteer，一种轻量级的解码时广告框架，通过自适应调整词元概率，将上下文相关的广告内容自然融入响应中。AdSteer校准了广告影响的强度和持续时间，使赞助内容成为响应的自然组成部分。在GEM-Bench上的三个应用场景实验表明，AdSteer相比最强基线平均提升14.1%的整体得分，且平均比基于重写的方案减少22.5%的总词元数。这些结果表明，AdSteer为LLM中的原生广告提供了有效且实用的解决方案。

summary: Small students degrade on large reasoning models' (LRMs') long solutions, so recent work shortens them by interpolating an LRM with a short-answer model at ratio $λ$. We ask what student weights retain when this teacher stops thinking, comparing LoRA adapters of three students from three teacher pairs at each $λ$. In each pair, the adapters' update subspace shifts most where the teacher stops thinking and solutions shorten most, locating the change without attributing it. We identify a shared adapter subspace tied to thinking-like behavior (reflective markers, monologue format and long solutions). Shared by adapters before that point, it keeps about half (post hoc) while one pair's teacher halves its solutions but keeps its think tag, and largely empties after thinking stops. Removing it largely turns this behavior off for every pair, student and benchmark. Only in that pair and one other student does it leave clearly fewer markers than removing the update's top components; elsewhere, same-energy random directions often nearly match it. Grafted into a short-answer student at twice its weight, it turns early markers (a post hoc count) on, like the whole update, but the student rarely finishes. Our work identifies a weight subspace tied to distilled thinking-like behavior.
title: Where Do Distilled Students Store Thinking?

title_translated: 蒸馏学生模型如何存储思维过程？
summary_translated: 小型学生模型在处理大型推理模型（LRMs）的长推理路径时性能下降，因此近期工作通过在比例λ处将LRM与短答案模型进行插值来缩短路径。我们探究当教师模型停止思考时，学生模型权重保留了什么，通过比较三组教师-学生对在不同λ值下的LoRA适配器更新子空间。在每一对中，适配器更新子空间的变化最显著的位置恰好对应教师模型停止思考且路径最短之处，从而定位变化而不需归因。我们识别出一个共享的适配器子空间，与思维类行为相关（如反思标记、独白格式和长路径）。该子空间在该点之前由所有适配器共享，之后约一半（事后分析）仍保留；在一个教师模型将其路径减半但仍保留“思考”标签的案例中，该子空间部分保留；而在思维停止后则基本清空。移除该子空间会彻底关闭所有教师-学生对、学生模型和基准测试中的此类行为。只有在那一对和另一个学生中，移除该子空间留下的标记明显少于移除更新主成分的情况；其他情况下，同能量的随机方向往往能近似匹配。将该子空间以两倍权重嫁接到短答案学生模型中，可激活早期标记（事后计数），如同整个更新一样，但学生很少能完成生成。我们的研究揭示了一个与蒸馏思维类行为相关的权重子空间。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) often generate responses longer than necessary, increasing inference latency and computational cost. While prompting can encourage conciseness, controlling output length without compromising response completeness remains challenging. Aggressive early stopping can reduce generation costs but risks terminating responses prematurely. We introduce MinimalLM, a training-free framework for reliable verbosity control that combines uncertainty-aware, length-dependent stop-token adjustment with structural completeness guardrails. MinimalLM separates the decision of when to stop from whether stopping is structurally appropriate, coordinating response-level instructions, decoding-time intervention, and completion checks without modifying model parameters or requiring auxiliary models. We evaluate MinimalLM across three open-source LLMs and 330 questions, producing 5,940 responses across baseline and ablation configurations. MinimalLM reduces generated tokens by 47.6%, accelerates individual responses by 19-68%, and eliminates structurally truncated outputs in the primary evaluation. Despite substantial token savings, it achieves an average quality score of 8.04/10, compared with 8.42/10 for unmodified models and 6.46/10 for length-matched truncation. Evaluations across diverse subject domains (such as healthcare, programming, law, and science) demonstrate robust efficiency gains, while ablations establish the complementary roles of decoding control and completeness constraints. Our findings highlight that efficient generation requires more than producing fewer tokens: it requires controlling when generation ends while preserving response integrity. MinimalLM offers a lightweight, training-free approach toward this goal.
title: Say Less, Mean Better: Training-Free Verbosity Control for Language Models

title_translated: 说得更少，表达更好：面向语言模型的免训练冗余控制
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常生成过长的响应，增加了推理延迟和计算成本。虽然提示可以鼓励简洁性，但控制输出长度而不牺牲响应完整性仍具挑战。激进的早期终止虽可降低生成成本，但可能导致响应提前结束。我们提出MinimalLM，一种免训练的可靠冗余控制框架，结合了基于不确定性的、与长度相关的停止词元调整，以及结构完整性保障机制。MinimalLM将何时停止的决策与是否停止在结构上合理分开，协调响应级指令、解码时干预和完成检查，无需修改模型参数或依赖辅助模型。我们在三个开源LLM上评估MinimalLM，共生成5,940个响应，涵盖基线和消融配置。MinimalLM将生成词元数减少47.6%，单个响应加速19%-68%，并在主要评估中完全消除结构截断输出。尽管大幅节省词元，其平均质量得分为8.04/10，优于未修改模型的8.42/10，也远高于长度匹配截断的6.46/10。在医疗、编程、法律和科学等多样主题领域的评估显示稳健的效率提升，消融实验也证实了解码控制与完整性约束的互补作用。研究结果强调，高效生成不仅意味着生成更少词元，更需精准控制生成终止时机以保持响应完整性。MinimalLM提供了一种轻量、免训练的方法以实现这一目标。

summary: NLP evaluation reports routinely cite sliced performance differences, most prominently the intra-inter gap in document-level relation extraction, as capability evidence. We show that such gap readings are joint properties of models and evaluation contracts: scoring function, gold version, threshold, output format, and prompt language. With predictions frozen, a method ordering reverses under a gold-standard exchange (+0.0363, CI excluding zero; tie-level after), movement localizing where gold re-partitions: renames are gauge transformations (Delta=0; re-annotation +0.862). We formalize this as an evaluation leverage account centered on the rank-flip condition. Constructively, the audited evaluation reading (AER) is a contract-marginalized, tie-declared, seed-prescribed, gate-filtered procedure whose tie declarations cover every contract-induced flip on the declared WMT19 grids (14/14; held-out 73% vs. union-of-ties 89%), matching the best single metric contract at epsilon=0.10 equivalence. Evidence spans DocRE, HacRED, a UD probe, and released gold revisions; an alternative-reference-set replication extends it beyond our testbeds. Failed predictions retained as boundaries; a 5% violation gate flags unverifiable settings and bounds survivor-selection bias. We release EvalLever, a preregistered workflow with an amendment trail; on LLM-as-judge grids, the audited ensemble stabilizes every unstable pair (13-15 to zero; generic ensemble shrinkage: the preregistered correlation criterion failed, the companion stabilization criterion passed).
title: Evaluation Contracts and Evaluation Leverage: Sliced-Gap Readings in Structured Prediction Can Move Without Model Change

title_translated: 评估契约与评估杠杆：结构化预测中的切片差距无需模型变更即可移动
summary_translated: 自然语言处理的评估报告经常引用切片性能差异，尤其是文档级关系抽取中的内部-外部差距，作为能力证据。我们表明，这些差距读数是模型与评估契约的联合属性：评分函数、真实标签版本、阈值、输出格式和提示语言。在预测固定的情况下，方法排序会在标准真实标签交换下反转（+0.0363，置信区间不包含零；平局水平后），其变动定位在真实标签重新划分的位置：重命名是规范变换（Delta=0；重新标注 +0.862）。我们将其形式化为以排名翻转条件为核心的评估杠杆理论。建设性地，审计评估读数（AER）是一种契约边际化、平局声明、种子指定、门控过滤的过程，其平局声明覆盖了所有在声明的WMT19网格上由契约引发的翻转（14/14；保留集73% vs. 平局并集89%），在ε=0.10等价条件下匹配最佳单指标契约。证据涵盖DocRE、HacRED、UD探测和已发布的真值修订；替代参考集复现将该结论扩展至我们的测试范围之外。失败预测被保留为边界；5%违规门限标记不可验证设置并限制幸存者选择偏差。我们发布了EvalLever，一个预注册工作流并带有修改记录；在LLM作为裁判的网格上，审计集成稳定了每一个不稳定的配对（13-15降至零；通用集成收缩：预注册相关性标准失败，配套稳定标准通过）。

summary: Services that operate in Korean often write their evaluation rubrics in Korean and hand them to an LLM judge. We test whether a judge's verdict depends on the language of the rubric and on how a rubric item is phrased. We write 12 criteria for support dialogues in four clause structures (affirmative, negated, conditional, exception) such that two pairs of structures have the same meaning, and we give each item in Korean and in English. Six low-cost models from three providers, plus one reference model, judge 60 translated ESConv dialogues and 144 constructed boundary cases under every combination (51,744 requests across the seven models). The analysis plan was fixed and committed before data collection. Cross-provider agreement is lower with Korean rubrics than with English rubrics (Cohen's kappa 0.687 vs. 0.745; difference -0.058, 95% CI [-0.072,-0.045]). Disagreement concentrates in negated, conditional, and exception items (odds ratio 5.6 relative to affirmative items). A single model changes its verdict between two items with the same meaning in 11-15% of cases. Two hypotheses are not supported: models from the same provider do not agree more than models from different providers, and adding paired examples does not reduce the language gap. We measure consistency only; no human labels are used, and all materials were drafted by an LLM.
title: Same Rule, Different Verdicts: Rubric Language and Clause Structure in LLM Judges for Korean Support Dialogues

title_translated: 同一规则，不同裁决：大语言模型裁判在韩语支持对话中的评分标准语言与从句结构影响
summary_translated: 在韩语环境中运营的服务通常使用韩语编写评估标准，并交由大语言模型裁判进行评判。我们测试裁判的裁决是否依赖于评分标准的语言以及评分项的表述方式。我们设计了12个支持对话的标准，采用四种从句结构（肯定、否定、条件、例外），其中两对结构含义相同，并将每个项目分别用韩语和英语呈现。六种来自三个提供商的低成本模型，加上一个参考模型，对60个翻译后的ESConv对话和144个构造的边界案例在每种组合下进行评判（共51,744次请求，涉及七种模型）。分析计划在数据收集前已固定并承诺。跨提供商的一致性在韩语标准下低于英语标准（Cohen's kappa 0.687 vs. 0.745；差异 -0.058，95% CI [-0.072,-0.045]）。分歧集中在否定、条件和例外项中（相对于肯定项的几率比为5.6）。单一模型在两个含义相同的项目间改变裁决的比例为11-15%。两个假设未获支持：同一提供商的模型并不比不同提供商的模型更一致，增加成对示例也无法缩小语言差距。我们仅测量一致性；未使用人类标签，所有材料均由大语言模型起草。

summary: Practitioners who compare systems with an LLM judge and have no human labels often check a conclusion by repeating it with a judge from another provider. We test how far that check can be trusted. In a preregistered study (with a disclosed post-registration reduction of the judge set), five judge models from three providers re-judged 4,000 Chatbot Arena battles (nine systems, 33 system pairs) that carry human votes, each in both response orders. Agreement with the human vote was low at the verdict level (median Cohen's kappa = 0.22), and system rankings did not survive a change of judge: Kendall's tau with the human ranking ranged from 0.17 to 0.89 (median 0.67), so the preregistered hypothesis that rankings remain stable was not supported. Conclusions replicated by two low-cost judges from different providers matched the human conclusion more often than single-judge conclusions (+0.10 precision), but the gain came from filtering out one poorly aligned judge, and replication involving that judge left a conclusion for only 35% of comparisons. Judges that agreed with humans reached a stable conclusion with no more verdicts than human votes required; the others failed to converge on 26-70% of system pairs at the sample sizes tested (up to 100 verdicts per pair). Disagreements with the human vote co-occurred across judges far more often than independence predicts, although a single human vote per battle cannot separate shared judge bias from voter noise.
title: Swapping the Judge Changes the Ranking: A Preregistered Study of Cross-Provider Replication in LLM-Judged System Comparisons

title_translated: 更换裁判即改变排名：大语言模型裁判系统比较中的跨提供商复现预注册研究
summary_translated: 实践中，使用大语言模型裁判且无真人标签的从业者常通过换用另一提供商的裁判来验证结论。我们测试这种验证能有多可信。在一项预注册研究中（披露了注册后对裁判集合的缩减），来自三个提供商的五个裁判模型重新评判了4,000场Chatbot Arena对决（九个系统，33个系统对），每场以两种响应顺序进行。在裁决层面与人类投票的一致性较低（中位数Cohen's kappa = 0.22），且系统排名在裁判更换后无法保持稳定：与人类排名的Kendall's tau在0.17到0.89之间（中位数0.67），因此预注册假设——排名保持稳定——未被支持。由两个不同提供商的低成本裁判复现的结论比单裁判结论更接近人类结论（精度提升+0.10），但收益来自剔除一个表现不佳的裁判，而涉及该裁判的复现仅使结论成立率维持在35%。与人类一致的裁判能以少于人类投票数量的裁决达成稳定结论；其他裁判在测试样本量下（最多每对100个裁决）未能收敛的比例为26%-70%。裁判与人类投票的分歧共现频率远高于独立性预测，尽管每场对决只有一个真人投票，无法区分共享裁判偏见与投票噪声。

summary: Offline multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) aims to learn a unified policy from heterogeneous offline datasets that generalizes across tasks. However, existing offline MTRL methods often struggle with two fundamental issues: severe per-task data scarcity and limited cross-task generalization. In this paper, we propose Language-Model Augmented Decision Transformer (LaMA-DT), a unified sequence-modeling framework that leverages a single large language model (LLM) for both trajectory augmentation and multi-task policy learning. LaMA-DT uses natural-language task descriptions to guide task-aligned trajectory augmentation through a set of supervised generation and alignment objectives, and incorporates a scoring-and-filtering mechanism to retain high-quality augmented trajectories. The same LLM is then repurposed as a language-conditioned Decision Transformer and fine-tuned on a mixture of real and augmented data. Experiments on Meta-World and MuJoCo multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that LaMA-DT consistently outperforms competitive baselines, particularly in low-data regimes, showing that language-guided data augmentation substantially improves cross-task generalization.
title: Language Model Augmented Decision Transformer for Multi-Task Offline Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 语言模型增强的决策变压器用于多任务离线强化学习
summary_translated: 离线多任务强化学习（MTRL）旨在从异构的离线数据集中学习统一策略，实现跨任务泛化。然而，现有离线MTRL方法常面临两个根本问题：严重的每任务数据稀缺性和有限的跨任务泛化能力。本文提出语言模型增强的决策变压器（LaMA-DT），一种统一的序列建模框架，利用单一大型语言模型（LLM）同时实现轨迹增强和多任务策略学习。LaMA-DT使用自然语言任务描述，通过一组监督生成和对齐目标引导任务对齐的轨迹增强，并引入评分与筛选机制保留高质量增强轨迹。随后，同一LLM被重新用于作为语言条件化的决策变压器，在真实与增强数据混合上进行微调。在Meta-World和MuJoCo多任务基准上的实验表明，LaMA-DT始终优于竞争基线，尤其在低数据场景下表现突出，证明语言引导的数据增强显著提升了跨任务泛化能力。

summary: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.
title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
title_translated: Dory1.0-4B：循环归一化GPT
summary_translated: 我们介绍Dory1.0-4B，一个40亿参数的循环（潜在递归）语言模型，具有弹性深度：单一检查点可适应不同的推理计算预算。Dory1.0-4B基于归一化Transformer（nGPT）主干，包含交错的滑动窗口层和全注意力层，分为输入块、共享递归块和输出块。推理时，递归块可执行可变次数。我们在6万亿token上预训练Dory1.0-4B，前4.5万亿token在NVFP4下训练，后续预训练将上下文长度扩展至256K token。接着，我们使用监督微调（SFT）和可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）对模型进行后训练，采用难度感知的循环课程，将更难的提示导向更深的循环。增加循环次数可提升准确性，尤其在编码、智能体和长上下文基准上收益最大。当循环次数为两个或以上时，Dory1.0-4B在12个基准上的平均表现优于更大的模型如Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B和Gemma 4 26B-A4B。循环还使Dory1.0-4B在智能体基准上更具令牌效率：四次循环生成的令牌数仅为一次循环的1.3-2.5倍，因为额外计算发生在潜在空间而非生成更长输出。为减少循环期间的内存占用，Dory1.0-4B仅缓存最后一次循环的键值，使其KV缓存占用始终等于非循环模型，同时保留大部分准确率增益。我们开源了BF16、MXFP8、NVFP4和GGUF量化检查点。

summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly advise backers on which crowdfunding campaigns to support. LLMs have known race and gender problems, and it is unsettled whether they reproduce, erase, or reverse the discrimination documented in entrepreneurial finance. We ask when, and through which decision process, LLM assistants use founders' gender and ethnicity. In a pre-specified choice-based conjoint experiment, seven LLMs chose among five synthetic campaigns with independently randomized quality signals and founder names, under three backer personas and a persona-free control (40,248 responses). By default, founder names barely matter: under budget-conscious and delivery-focused personas, gender and Black-name effects are statistically equivalent to zero. When the backer wants to support underrepresented creators, the models favor Black-signaled (+8.1 percentage points; positive in all seven models) and female-signaled (+5.1) founders. They do so most strongly among near-tied campaigns and for the founder who alone carries the signal, and they almost never name gender or ethnicity in their reasons. The results fit an agency account of algorithmic discrimination: an aligned assistant takes its demographic preferences from its user rather than from its training data.
title: Whose startup does the AI back? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in LLM-assisted crowdfunding

title_translated: AI支持哪个创业项目？基于大语言模型辅助众筹中声誉与人口统计信号的算法审计
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）助手越来越多地为支持者提供应资助哪些众筹项目的建议。LLMs存在已知的种族和性别问题，尚不清楚它们是否会复制、消除或逆转创业金融中记录的歧视现象。我们研究了在何种情况下以及通过何种决策过程，LLM助手会使用创始人的性别和族裔信息。在预先设定的选择性联合实验中，七个LLM在三种支持者角色和一个无角色控制条件下，从五个具有独立随机质量信号和创始人姓名的合成项目中进行选择（共40,248次响应）。默认情况下，创始人姓名几乎无关紧要：在预算敏感和交付导向的角色下，性别和黑人姓名效应在统计上等同于零。当支持者希望支持代表性不足的创作者时，模型更倾向于黑人信号（+8.1个百分点；所有七个模型均为正向）和女性信号（+5.1）的创始人。这种偏好在接近平局的项目中最强，并且仅当创始人单独携带该信号时最为明显；但它们几乎从不明确提及性别或族裔作为理由。结果符合算法歧视的代理理论：一个对齐的助手会根据用户而非训练数据来获取其人口统计偏好。

summary: Long-context inference is bound by the KV cache, which 2-bit codes could shrink about sixfold if their error stays in check. The usual remedy rotates keys before quantizing, assuming rotation always helps. However, we observe that it does not: rotation flattens a spiky piece of a key but can give a flat one a new peak, and both coexist within one key. We therefore propose FlagRot, which stores each 32-channel piece rotated or as is, whichever has the smaller calibrated attention error, and rotates the query instead when reading. We further show that how often to decide follows the quantization axis: per-channel caches such as KIVI need one decision per head, at no write cost, while per-token caches decide per key, with the choice stored in existing sign bits. At 2.5 bits per value, FlagRot lowers the twelve-model KL divergence of KIVI from 18.7 to 12.4 x 10^-3, below RotateKV on 9 of 12 models. Served as a vLLM plugin, it raises RULER at 128k tokens by +2.9 points and the LongBench v1 mean by +0.4 to +1.9 points on the three of four models where 2-bit KIVI loses accuracy. It also lowers the error of 4-bit integer and FP4 caches.
title: FlagRot: Selective Rotation for Low-Bit KV Caches

title_translated: FlagRot：用于低比特KV缓存的选择性旋转
summary_translated: 长上下文推理受限于KV缓存，若误差可控，2比特编码可将其缩小约六倍。通常的做法是在量化前旋转键，假设旋转总是有益的。然而我们发现并非如此：旋转会压平键的一个尖峰，但也可能使原本平坦的部分产生新峰值，两者可能同时存在于一个键中。因此我们提出FlagRot，即对每个32通道的片段存储旋转后或原样版本中校准注意力误差较小的一种，并在读取时旋转查询。我们进一步表明，决策频率应遵循量化轴：每通道缓存（如KIVI）每头只需一次决策，无需写入开销；而每标记缓存则每键决策一次，选择可存储在现有符号位中。在每值2.5比特时，FlagRot将KIVI的十二模型KL散度从18.7降至12.4×10⁻³，在12个模型中有9个优于RotateKV。作为vLLM插件部署时，它在128k令牌下使RULER提升+2.9分，LongBench v1平均提升+0.4至+1.9分（在四个模型中，2比特KIVI精度下降的三个模型中表现优异）。同时，它也降低了4比特整数和FP4缓存的误差。

summary: Enterprises increasingly want LLM agents to automate standard operating procedures over their software stacks -- mapping each step of a procedure to the right call among thousands of internal APIs, without hand-authored step-to-API mappings. The core difficulty is API selection at scale: choosing and composing the correct tools over a long horizon, judged only by whether the overall task succeeds. Current tool-use benchmarks do not test this regime -- they expose only a handful of tools, evaluate single-step invocation, or grade multi-step behavior with subjective LLM-as-a-judge scores that penalize valid alternative trajectories. We introduce SLATE (Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit for E-commerce), a large-scale benchmark that tests large-toolset, long-horizon API selection in a realistic enterprise domain. SLATE couples (i) queries decomposed into hierarchical, tool-grounded procedures over a ~1,000-tool e-commerce library, (ii) a deterministic, context-aware simulator that returns recorded outputs for matching calls and default responses otherwise, and (iii) an end-to-end task-success metric -- a task succeeds when it reaches every reference outcome -- that credits diverse-but-valid trajectories while remaining fully automatic and reproducible. Experiments with six open decision models and the language models they are built on, from 3B to 12B parameters, show that even the best model completes only 5.0% of the tasks, establishing SLATE as a challenging testbed for reliable enterprise tool use. We release SLATE, its simulator, and the evaluation harness at https://geshijoker.github.io/slate/
title: SLATE: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon API Selection in E-commerce Tool Use
comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Camera-ready version for the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET). Project page: this https URL
title_translated: SLATE：电商工具使用中长周期API选择的大规模基准测试
summary_translated: 企业越来越希望LLM代理能够自动化其软件栈中的标准操作流程——将每个步骤映射到数千个内部API中的正确调用，而无需人工编写步骤到API的映射。核心难点在于大规模的API选择：在长周期内选择并组合正确的工具，仅以整体任务是否成功来评判。当前的工具使用基准测试并未检验这一场景——它们仅暴露少量工具，评估单步调用，或使用主观的LLM作为裁判评分来评价多步行为，从而惩罚有效的替代路径。我们引入SLATE（电商领域大规模API工具包），一个大规模基准测试，用于在真实的企事业领域中测试大规模工具集、长周期API选择。SLATE结合了（i）分解为层次化、工具基础程序的查询，基于约1000个工具的电商库；（ii）确定性的、上下文感知的模拟器，对匹配调用返回记录输出，否则返回默认响应；（iii）端到端的任务成功率指标——当任务达到所有参考结果时视为成功——既奖励多样但有效的路径，又保持完全自动和可复现。使用六个开放决策模型及其构建的语言模型（参数量从3B到12B）进行实验，结果显示即使最佳模型也仅完成5.0%的任务，确立了SLATE作为可靠企业工具使用的挑战性测试平台。我们已发布SLATE、其模拟器和评估框架，网址为https://geshijoker.github.io/slate/

summary: Small language models (<=9B parameters) can support local medical question answering (QA) while reducing privacy and latency concerns, but effective fine-tuning remains challenging. This paper compares two chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning methods: Uniform-across-Sequence (UaS), which applies equal loss weighting to the full CoT-and-answer sequence, and Segment-weighted (SwS), which separately weights CoT and answer losses. We evaluate six general- and medical-domain models on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA) and free-text QA (Med-O1). Results show that neither method is universally best: on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA), SwS generally performs better, with general-purpose models benefiting most; notably, Qwen3.5-4B improves by up to 44.8% over its zero-shot baseline on MedQA. In contrast, medical-domain models show smaller or even negative gains on MCQs. On free-text QA (Med-O1), UaS performs best for nearly all models and provides consistent improvements across both model types, with the 3B Llama-3.2 model approaching the performance of much larger 7B medical-domain models. We also find that excessively long CoT generation is associated with lower performance in some models on either multiple-choice or free-text QA tasks, suggesting that limiting the CoT length during training may benefit selected models. Overall, the results show that CoT loss weighting should be matched to the task format and the knowledge already encoded in the base model, rather than using a single fine-tuning strategy for all clinical QA tasks.
title: Balancing Chain-of-Thought and Answer Supervision for Small Language Models on Medical Question Answering
title_translated: 平衡思维链与答案监督以优化小语言模型在医学问答中的表现
summary_translated: 小型语言模型（≤9B参数）可在减少隐私和延迟风险的同时支持本地医学问答，但有效微调仍具挑战性。本文比较了两种思维链（CoT）监督微调方法：跨序列均匀加权（UaS），对完整的思维链与答案序列施加相等损失权重；以及分段加权（SwS），分别对思维链和答案损失进行加权。我们在多个通用和医学领域模型上评估了多项选择题问答（MedQA和EMS-MCQA）和自由文本问答（Med-O1）。结果表明，两种方法并无绝对优劣：在多项选择题（MedQA和EMS-MCQA）上，SwS通常表现更好，通用模型受益最显著；值得注意的是，Qwen3.5-4B在MedQA上的表现相比零样本基线最高提升44.8%。相比之下，医学领域模型在MCQ上收益较小甚至出现负增长。在自由文本问答（Med-O1）上，UaS对几乎所有模型表现最佳，并在两类模型上均提供一致改进，其中3B的Llama-3.2模型性能接近更大规模的7B医学领域模型。我们还发现，某些模型在多项选择或自由文本问答任务中，过长的思维链生成与较低性能相关，提示在训练中限制思维链长度可能有利于特定模型。总体而言，结果表明思维链损失加权应根据任务格式及基础模型中已编码的知识进行匹配，而非对所有临床问答任务采用单一微调策略。

summary: With the rise of Group Agent such as Claude Tag, agents increasingly serve as digital workers for long-term team collaboration. These agents operate over shared contexts that continuously accumulate through multi-user interactions. However, existing agent memory systems are mainly designed for individual users and struggle to capture group-level knowledge in shared contexts, including group relationships and collaboratively formed knowledge. Manual memory strategies further limit adaptation to diverse and evolving shared contexts. To this end, we propose \textbf{EvoGroup (EvoG)}, a self-evolving harness for group agents that starts from a minimal six-tool cold start and adapts through interaction with shared context. EvoG uses confidence and task outcomes to select informative trajectories, while also eliciting self-reflections on uncertainty in low-confidence cases. The analysis agent then examines selected trajectories through adaptive progressive disclosure, followed by bucketed analysis to synthesize high-level findings that guide the evolve agent in revising the Harness. Empirically, pass@1 on held-out split of EverMemBench improves from 71.07\% to 89.58\%, surpassing both self-evolving memory and human-designed harnesses, including Claude Code (85.83\%). To evaluate generalization, we freeze the evolved harness and evaluate it on the unseen GroupMemBench, where, with GPT-5.5, it demonstrates effective generalization and outperforms both memory baselines and human-designed harnesses.
title: EvoGroup: A Self-Evolving Harness for Group Agents in Shared Contexts

title_translated: EvoGroup：共享环境中群组智能体的自演化框架
summary_translated: 随着群组智能体（如Claude Tag）的兴起，智能体越来越多地作为数字员工参与长期团队协作。这些智能体在持续积累的多用户交互中运行于共享上下文中。然而，现有的智能体记忆系统主要针对单个用户设计，难以捕捉共享上下文中的群体级知识，包括群体关系和协作形成的认知。手动记忆策略进一步限制了对多样化且不断演化的共享上下文的适应能力。为此，我们提出	extbf{EvoGroup（EvoG）}，一种面向群组智能体的自演化框架，从最小的六工具冷启动开始，通过与共享上下文的交互实现自适应。EvoG利用置信度和任务结果选择有信息量的轨迹，同时在低置信度情况下激发自我反思以应对不确定性。分析代理随后通过自适应渐进披露检查所选轨迹，并采用分桶分析合成高层见解，指导演化代理修订框架。实证结果显示，EverMemBench保留分割的pass@1从71.07%提升至89.58%，超越自演化记忆和人工设计框架（包括Claude Code的85.83%）。为评估泛化能力，我们冻结演化后的框架并在未见的GroupMemBench上进行评估，结果显示在GPT-5.5下具备有效泛化能力，优于所有记忆基线和人工设计框架。

summary: Reasoning substantially improves language models' ability to solve difficult problems, but long reasoning traces make these gains expensive. Efficient reasoning should express useful analysis in fewer tokens by reducing repetition and text that adds little value to solving the problem. Progress in proprietary models motivates this goal, yet their hidden scratchpads limit direct study of how it is achieved. We investigate whether open-weight models can generate less verbose reasoning by changing the form of their own earlier thoughts, without retraining. Our intervention rewrites prior reasoning into compact state records before pending tool results are revealed, then compares continuations from original and compact histories. Across the tested models, accepted compact histories usually shorten future reasoning; a coding case study also shows less repeated verification after a shared candidate solution. In software-agent deployments, compaction can reduce total spending, although task quality and rewrite-inclusive time depend on the target and compressor. These findings identify reasoning history as one way to reduce future reasoning-token use and motivate model-specific compaction policies evaluated for both efficiency and retained capability.
title: Why Pay for Long Reasoning When Rewrite Do Trick? Causal Effects of Reasoning History Compaction on Future Generation and Agent Cost
title_translated: 为何在重写即可奏效时还要为长推理付费？推理历史压缩对后续生成与代理成本的因果影响
summary_translated: 推理显著提升了语言模型解决复杂问题的能力，但冗长的推理过程使其代价高昂。高效的推理应通过减少重复和低价值文本，在更少的词元中表达有用分析。专有模型的进步推动了这一目标，但其隐藏的草稿区限制了对实现方式的直接研究。我们探究开放权重模型是否可通过改变自身早期思维的形式（无需重新训练）生成更简洁的推理。我们的干预在待处理工具结果揭示前，将先前推理重写为紧凑的状态记录，然后比较原始与紧凑历史的后续延续。在测试模型中，接受的紧凑历史通常能缩短未来的推理；一项编码案例研究也显示，在共享候选解决方案后，重复验证减少。在软件代理部署中，压缩可降低总支出，尽管任务质量和包含重写的耗时取决于目标和压缩器。这些发现表明，推理历史是减少未来推理词元使用的一种方式，并激励针对不同模型制定压缩策略，以兼顾效率与保留能力。

summary: Large language models provide a variety of responses at inference (generation) that conventionally depend on a temperature parameter. Using a conditional mutual information approach, a quantitative, entropy based analysis of response variety is given. Three limiting behaviors are defined: arbiter, independent (conditionally) and neutral (deterministic) that span no to maximal mutual information. We give examples of each behavior and suggest their application to: temperature analysis, language analysis, prompt compression, and knowledge graphs.
title: A Conditional Mutual Information Analysis of Response Variety in Language Models

title_translated: 基于条件互信息的语言模型响应多样性分析
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在推理（生成）阶段提供多样化的响应，传统上依赖温度参数进行控制。本文采用条件互信息方法，从熵的角度对响应多样性进行了量化分析。定义了三种极限行为：仲裁型、独立型（条件上）和中性型（确定性），涵盖从无到最大互信息的范围。我们给出了每种行为的示例，并建议其应用于温度分析、语言分析、提示压缩和知识图谱构建。

summary: Next-visit diagnosis prediction forecasts the diagnoses documented at a patient's next encounter, turning retrospective electronic health records into prospective clinical prediction. However, conventional aggregate evaluation obscures its multifaceted nature: distributionally, models must handle variable-size diagnosis sets and long-tailed labels; temporally, they must distinguish persistent, newly recorded, and recurrent diagnoses; and both vary with observed history depth. We introduce an evaluation framework along these dimensions and apply it to rule-based heuristics, LLM-based prompting, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent approaches. This reveals that repeating the last visit outperforms most LLM-based approaches overall despite predicting no new or recurrent diagnoses, and that retrieval and memory exhibit distinct profiles whose relative strengths vary across temporal transitions and backbones. Motivated by this, we propose LONGINUS, a retrieval-memory multi-agent adjudication framework combining evidence retrieved from patient records with structured memory of the patient trajectory. Using cross-view agreement as a reliability heuristic, it preserves shared predictions and adjudicates disagreements without revealing their source. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLM backbones, LONGINUS achieves the best transition-specific performance among LLM-based methods in nearly all settings while remaining competitive with them on aggregate metrics.
title: Rethinking Next-Visit Diagnosis Prediction Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Retrieval--Memory Multi-Agent Adjudication

title_translated: 超越聚合指标的再思考：检索-记忆多智能体裁决用于下次就诊诊断预测
summary_translated: 下次就诊诊断预测旨在预测患者下一次就诊时记录的诊断，将回顾性的电子健康记录转化为前瞻性临床预测。然而，传统的聚合评估掩盖了其多面性：在分布上，模型需处理可变大小的诊断集合和长尾标签；在时间上，需区分持续性、新记录和复发性诊断；且两者均随观测历史深度变化。我们提出了一个沿这些维度展开的评估框架，并应用于基于规则的启发式方法、基于大语言模型的提示、检索、记忆及多智能体方法。结果显示，重复上一次就诊的预测整体优于大多数基于LLM的方法，尽管它不预测新或复发诊断；而检索与记忆表现出不同的特征，其相对优势在不同时间转换和模型架构间变化。受此启发，我们提出LONGINUS——一种结合从患者记录中检索证据与患者轨迹结构化记忆的检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架。利用跨视图一致性作为可靠性启发式，该框架保留一致预测并裁决分歧，而不暴露分歧来源。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上，使用四种LLM骨干网络，LONGINUS在几乎所有设置中均实现了基于LLM方法的最佳过渡特定性能，同时在聚合指标上仍保持竞争力。

summary: Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) aligns a language model to a general preference function by approximating the Nash equilibrium of a two-player preference game. Its practical variant, DNO-Prct, iterates on-policy sampling, LLM-based rating of the samples together with a teacher's gold response, large-margin preference-pair selection and a DPO-style contrastive update. We re-implement DNO-Prct independently and study it on two open-weight instruct models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, with GPT-4o or a larger open-weight model of the same family as the annotator. On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o as judge, three iterations raise the length-controlled (LC) win rate against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win rate. With same-family open-weight annotators, the runs retain 62% (Llama) and 82% (Mistral) of the LC gain achieved with GPT-4o as annotator, so the rating step does not require a proprietary model. In a separate ablation configuration, variants that remove the gold responses, remove the data look-back, or accept only teacher-preferred pairs score 6 to 10 LC points below the full procedure, whereas varying the number of on-policy samples per prompt (1 to 7) moves the LC win rate by at most 2.1 points, and a margin sweep (1 to 5) run in its own pipeline by at most 2.4 points. We also report the cost of the pipeline and where the practical algorithm departs from the theory it approximates. All results are single runs, and GPT-4o is both the teacher and the evaluation judge; we discuss what this implies for the reported gains.
title: Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization

title_translated: 对齐语言模型与通用偏好：直接纳什优化的实证研究
summary_translated: 直接纳什优化（DNO）通过近似双人偏好博弈的纳什均衡，将语言模型对齐于通用偏好函数。其实际变体DNO-Prct迭代执行策略内采样、基于LLM的样本评分（结合教师的真实响应）、大间隔偏好对选择以及类似DPO的对比更新。我们独立复现了DNO-Prct，并在两个开源指令模型Llama 3.1 8B Instruct和Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1上进行研究，使用GPT-4o或同家族更大的开源模型作为标注者。在AlpacaEval 2.0上以GPT-4o为裁判，三次迭代使Llama在长度控制（LC）对GPT-4o的胜率从31.7%提升至45.3%，Mistral则从6.8%升至18.4%；调优后的8B模型在所有报告的胜率上均超过Llama 3.1 70B Instruct。当使用同家族开源标注者时，实验保留了GPT-4o标注者所获LC增益的62%（Llama）和82%（Mistral），说明评分步骤无需专有模型。在另一消融配置中，移除真实响应、移除数据回溯或仅接受教师偏好的对，得分比完整流程低6至10个LC点；而每提示的策略内样本数（1至7）变化仅使LC胜率波动最多2.1点，边际扫描（1至5）在独立流水线中最多影响2.4点。我们还报告了流水线的成本及其与理论近似的偏离之处。所有结果均为单次运行，GPT-4o既是教师也是评估裁判；我们讨论了这对其报告增益的影响。

summary: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to $10^{-11}$ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches $76.98 \pm 0.17$% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size ($76.62 \pm 0.36$%). Deleting the word its evidence ranks first changes the answer in 45% of test pairs, out of the 53% any single deletion can change, against 32% for the softmax model explained the same way and 40% by its attention x gradient. Attention can look more like the words annotators highlighted, yet accounts for the answer less well: deleting the word it ranks first changes the Born Transformer's answer in 32% of pairs. The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic optics and to qubits, and a coherent attention layer becomes one circuit equal to the model (852 CNOTs on 23 qubits). On IBM's ibm_kingston, reading only the attention overlaps by Hadamard tests, the device gave the model's answers on two short test pairs and kept or changed them under deletion as the model does; the evidence itself did not yet survive the device, and we work out the shots and calibration that measuring it on hardware would need.
title: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits

title_translated: 阅读原因：基于精确词证据的诞生-测量注意力机制在轻量级与量子比特上的实现
summary_translated: 当语言模型作答时，我们通常只能估算其原因。我们构建了一种Transformer，其中每一步都是一个诞生测量——注意力 $| ra{q}  ket{k}|^4$ 在每行上归一化，用测量乘积替代前馈非线性，以及一个诞生读出。在保持分母为输入值的情况下，每个类别概率是词幅值的多项式，因此其积分梯度证据可通过有限求积精确计算，无求积误差：词的贡献总和等于类别概率超出无信息部分的值，精度达 $10^{-11}$ 或更高。在e-SNLI自然语言推理任务上，使用约98k个外部参数，该模型达到 $76.98 \± 0.17$% 的测试准确率，与同规模的softmax Transformer（$76.62 \± 0.36$%）相当。删除其证据排名第一的词会使答案在45%的测试对中发生变化，占所有单个删除可改变情况的53%；而softmax模型相同解释方式下为32%，注意力×梯度解释为40%。注意力虽看起来更像标注者标出的词，但对答案的解释力却较差：删除证据排名第一的词仅使诞生Transformer的答案在32%的对中改变。相同权重可精确编译为光电光学系统和量子比特，且相干注意力层可构成一个等价电路（23量子比特上852个CNOT）。在IBM的ibm_kingston设备上，仅通过Hadamard测试读取注意力重叠，设备在两组短测试对上给出了模型的答案，并在删除时按模型逻辑保持或改变答案；但证据本身尚未在硬件上存活，我们推算了在硬件上测量它所需的采样次数和校准方案。

summary: Medical physicists turn a prescription into a delivered dose and check one another's calculations, because one error in a beam calibration or a monitor-unit (MU) calculation can affect every patient treated with it. MedPhysBench has ten seeded generators of calculation items in radiation therapy, diagnostic imaging, nuclear medicine and radiation protection, up to clinical tasks such as a TG-51 calibration worksheet. Reference answers come from code implementing the governing protocols, and a grader converts units and applies tolerance bands. From the same inputs, separate checking items test error detection, showing a colleague's worksheet or only the colleague's result, half correct and half with one planted error. On a held-out test split of 1,200 items (half for two models), 12 models scored 33.3 to 100.0% on calculation. Of the nine answers graded incorrect for the four best (99.3-100.0%), five contained model errors and four followed NCRP Report 151 on points our items misstate or leave open. Below them, most models did worst on level-3 clinical tasks, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 omitted the inverse-square correction in 19 of 20 isocentric MU items. Five models detected at least 96.7% of mostly large planted errors with at most 4% false alarms; for four of the other seven, checking only the result raised false alarms significantly. In an exploratory targeted test with 20 public cases of an omitted inverse-square correction, the three best models tested caught it in every worksheet, and three weaker models accepted 16 to 18 of 20 planted worksheets, one of them while applying the correction in most of its own calculations. Claude Opus 5.5 accepted 6 of 20 wrong results, although it applied the correction in all 20 of its own. We report the effect of two problems in our shielding items, found after the runs, and release the code, per-item outcomes and targeted-test responses.
title: MedPhysBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Medical Physics Calculations and Error Detection
title_translated: MedPhysBench：用于评估语言模型在医学物理计算与错误检测能力的基准测试
summary_translated: 医学物理师将处方转化为实际剂量，并相互检查计算结果，因为束流校准或监测单位（MU）计算中的一个错误可能影响所有接受治疗的患者。MedPhysBench 包含十个在放射治疗、诊断成像、核医学和辐射防护领域生成计算题目的种子生成器，涵盖临床任务如 TG-51 校准工作表。参考答案来自实现相关协议的代码，评分系统会进行单位转换并应用容差范围。从相同输入出发，独立的检查题目测试错误检测能力，包括展示同事的工作表或仅展示其结果，一半正确，一半包含人为植入的错误。在 1,200 个保留测试项（两个模型各半）上，12 个模型在计算任务上的得分介于 33.3% 到 100.0% 之间。在四个表现最佳模型（99.3–100.0%）中，九个被判定为错误的答案里，五个源于模型自身错误，四个遵循了 NCRP 报告 151 中我们题目中表述不清或未明确的要点。在较低表现模型中，大多数在三级临床任务上表现最差，Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 20 个等中心 MU 项目中有 19 个遗漏了反平方修正。五个模型能检测到至少 96.7% 的主要人为错误，且误报率不超过 4%；对于其余七个模型中的四个，仅检查结果会导致显著增加误报。在针对 20 个公开案例的探索性定向测试中，三个表现最好的模型在每份工作表中均发现了遗漏的反平方修正，而三个较弱模型接受了 16 至 18 份含错误的工作表，其中一个模型在自身多数计算中已应用该修正。Claude Opus 5.5 接受了 6 份错误结果，尽管其自身全部 20 次计算都应用了修正。我们报告了运行后发现的屏蔽项中的两个问题，并发布代码、逐项结果及定向测试响应。

summary: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.
title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
title_translated: LoopVQ：面向循环Transformer的亚1比特KV缓存量化方法
summary_translated: 循环Transformer是语言建模中一种参数高效的替代架构。通过在多个循环步骤中重复使用相同的层，近期的循环语言模型可达到非循环模型数倍规模下的性能水平。尽管该架构有效减少了参数内存占用，但每个循环步骤仍需存储独立的键值对，导致键值（KV）缓存随循环步数线性增长，成为主要的内存瓶颈。我们观察到循环模型的KV缓存沿循环轴高度冗余，且不同循环步骤对量化敏感度差异显著。基于此，我们提出 $	extbf{LoopVQ}$，一种针对循环Transformer的KV缓存向量量化方法，能够联合编码多个循环步骤的通道，并微调码本以匹配全精度模型的输出。在每元素 0.5 比特时，LoopVQ 在 Ouro 和 Huginn 模型上优于现有标准LLM的KV缓存量化方法，在通用长链推理和长上下文检索任务中表现更优。其设计与现有方法正交，与 TaSQ 结合后，即使在每元素 0.25 比特下仍能保持接近 BF16 的准确率。我们在 SGLang 中实现了 LoopVQ，在 32K token 上下文下几乎将解码延迟减半，并使 1.4B 和 2.6B Ouro 模型的峰值服务吞吐量分别提升至 4.3 倍和 6.1 倍于 BF16 基线。

summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow social scientists to analyze video at scale, but researchers must decide which parts of a video to provide as input. We use the term representation validity to examine how text, audio, video, and combined inputs affect measurement and subsequent analysis. We compare input representations across six open-weight MLLMs and three human-annotated video datasets. No representation consistently performs best. On seven news-related constructs, native-video performance varies little across models (macro-F1 = .70-.77), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80. Three models perform better with text and three with video. Combining inputs rarely improves performance. Higher classification accuracy also does not reliably produce estimates closer to those based on human codes. The highest-F1 representation best reproduces human-coded regression coefficients in 17 of 42 comparisons. Even when each model uses its highest-F1 deployable representation, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates differ from the human-coded benchmark by more than ten percentage points. Input representation therefore requires validation for both the construct being measured and the quantity estimated from the resulting labels.
title: What Does the Model See? Representation Validity in Multimodal LLM-Based Video Analysis
title_translated: 模型看到了什么？多模态大语言模型视频分析中的表示有效性
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）使社会科学家能够大规模分析视频，但研究者必须决定提供视频的哪些部分作为输入。我们使用“表示有效性”这一概念来考察文本、音频、视频以及组合输入如何影响测量结果及后续分析。我们在六种开源权重的 MLLM 和三种人工标注的视频数据集之间比较了输入表示。没有一种表示始终表现最优。在七个新闻相关构念上，原生视频表现跨模型变化不大（宏F1 = .70–.77），而提取文本的表现则在 .52 到 .80 之间波动。三个模型在文本输入上表现更好，三个在视频输入上表现更好。组合输入很少能提升性能。更高的分类准确率也并未可靠地产生更接近人工标注的结果。在 42 次比较中，最高F1表示在 17 次中能最好地复现人工标注的回归系数。即使每个模型使用其最高F1的可部署表示，仍有 45% 的样本流行度估计值与人工标注基准相差超过十个百分点。因此，输入表示需要针对所测量的构念以及由此标签推导出的数量进行验证。

summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads.
title: Heads That Write, Not Just Point: Image Retrieval Heads in Vision-Language Models

title_translated: 不只是指向：视觉-语言模型中的图像检索头
summary_translated: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）可以处理单个上下文中交错的文本和多张图像，但它们内部如何识别与问题相关的图像仍不清晰。我们以“上下文内图像检索”的形式研究这一定位步骤，并引入 ICIR-MCQ，一种用于头部层面分析图像检索的受控探测工具。通过分析每个头部在图像标记段上的注意力质量，我们首先识别出稀疏的指针头部，这些头部能可靠地指向目标图像。这些头部具有迁移能力：单个指针头部在自然场景多图像检索基准上表现可媲美外部视觉-语言检索器，表明 LVLM 内部存在强大的内部图像检索信号。然而，注意力仅显示头部读取的位置，而非其输出传递给后续层的信息内容，因此我们引入互补的输出侧分析。针对每个头部，我们训练一个轻量级图像检索器，基于其值加权输出，并用它识别出“写入头部”，即其输出包含足够信息以识别目标图像的头部。令人惊讶的是，指针标准与写入标准选择的头部集合显著不同，两者前100名头部中仅有 35 到 47 个重叠。针对性的集合划分消融实验表明，对标准多图像推理最重要的头部集中在指针-写入交集中，而仅由单一标准选出的头部与随机头部控制组的区分一致性较差。最一致的因果效应来自同时满足注意力指针和输出侧写入标准的头部。代码与数据：https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads。

summary: Post-training updates change what large language models (LLMs) can answer, but may leave their answerability judgments misaligned. We study this knowledge-judgment desynchronization through functional feeling of knowing (FoK), which supports selective generation, retrieval triggering, and model routing without implying subjective experience. We propose two trainable channels: a knowledge channel that changes answerability and a FoK channel that judges the current knowledge state. Three stages train them: on-policy supervised fine-tuning (OP-SFT) updates knowledge from corrected on-policy answers; knowledge-delta FoK training (K$Δ$-FT) adapts judgments across intermediate knowledge states; and FoK-guided policy optimization (FGPO) trains the subsequent answer or explanation. Factual-QA experiments, cross-dataset evaluation, and three sequential updates show that explicit FoK alignment improves judgment quality on updated knowledge. MMLU and ARC-Easy separately assess capability preservation.
title: Feeling of Knowing in Large Language Models

title_translated: 大型语言模型中的“知道感”
summary_translated: 后训练更新改变了大型语言模型（LLMs）的回答能力，但可能使其回答判断与实际知识状态脱节。我们通过功能性的“知道感”（FoK）研究这种知识-判断不同步现象，该机制支持选择性生成、检索触发和模型路由，而不涉及主观体验。我们提出两个可训练通道：一个知识通道用于改变回答能力，一个 FoK 通道用于判断当前知识状态。训练分为三个阶段：策略监督微调（OP-SFT）利用纠正后的策略回答更新知识；知识增量 FoK 训练（KΔ-FT）在中间知识状态间适应判断；FoK引导的策略优化（FGPO）训练后续回答或解释。事实问答实验、跨数据集评估及三次顺序更新表明，显式的 FoK 对齐提升了更新后知识状态下的判断质量。MMLU 和 ARC-Easy 分别评估能力保持情况。

summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.
title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
title_translated: 少思考，局部化：用于推理压缩的局部偏好学习
summary_translated: 大型推理模型在复杂任务上表现优异，但其漫长的思维链往往在获得足够信息后仍持续推理，导致显著的推理开销。现有的推理压缩方法主要针对推理轨迹进行操作，较少关注在当前状态下是否需要进一步推理的局部决策。我们提出了LoCo，一种用于推理压缩的局部偏好学习方法。LoCo从模型自身的推理轨迹中检测出过度思考的状态，冻结相应的推理前缀，从相同状态重新生成更短且经过验证的延续，并使用DPO对由此产生的状态条件偏好对进行训练。该方法教会模型何时继续推理、何时结束推理，而非简单地鼓励更短的轨迹。我们完全基于自生成的数学推理轨迹构建训练数据，并在五个数学和三个代码生成基准上评估LoCo。LoCo在数学任务上将完成长度减少41.7%–45.4%，在代码任务上减少23.4%–36.3%，同时保持或提升准确率，并在所有代码基准上取得最佳AUC。LoCo在数学任务上持续改善了准确率与效率的权衡，并在仅经过数学训练的情况下有效迁移至代码生成，展示了局部偏好学习在推理压缩中的跨领域通用性。代码和模型将公开发布于https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo。

summary: LLM agents often give conflicting answers to the same question, and many deployed agents are variants of one base model, so their errors are correlated. We study truth discovery among such agents: inferring the true answer and each agent's reliability without labels. Classical truth-discovery and crowdsourcing estimators reward an agreeing bloc and can fall below majority vote. We propose BP-TD, which adds per-agent decorrelation weights to mean-field variational inference on a one-coin Dawid-Skene model, so that agents sharing a base model count together as about one vote. Its first iteration is exactly a weighted vote; later iterations estimate agent reliability. With 13 local agents on MMLU, BP-TD beats majority vote without any labels (0.716 vs. 0.624 on 160 questions; 0.707 vs. 0.674 on 10,000) and ranks agents by their true accuracy, which classical estimators invert. The gain depends on the pool: over 2,852 sub-pools of four benchmarks, decorrelation helps when the largest correlated bloc is weaker than the other agents and hurts when it is the strongest, and we found no label-free statistic that tells the two cases apart. Labels change the picture quickly: with 20 labelled questions, selecting the single best agent is more accurate than every aggregator we tested on MMLU, ARC and TruthfulQA.
title: Where Is the Truth When AI Agents Disagree? Dependence-Aware Belief Propagation for Unsupervised Truth Discovery (Extended Version)

title_translated: 当AI代理意见相左时，真相何在？一种依赖感知的无监督真值发现方法（扩展版）
summary_translated: 大语言模型代理在回答同一问题时常给出冲突答案，且许多部署的代理是基于同一基础模型的变体，因此其错误具有相关性。我们研究此类代理间的真值发现：在无标签情况下推断真实答案及每个代理的可靠性。经典真值发现与众包估计器倾向于奖励一致的群体，可能低于多数投票结果。我们提出BP-TD，通过在单硬币Dawid-Skene模型的均场变分推断中引入每代理去相关权重，使共享同一基础模型的代理整体视为约一个投票。其首次迭代恰好为加权投票；后续迭代则估计代理可靠性。在MMLU上的13个本地代理实验中，BP-TD在无任何标签的情况下优于多数投票（160个问题上0.716 vs. 0.624；10,000个问题上0.707 vs. 0.674），并能正确排序代理的真实准确率，而经典估计器则会颠倒顺序。收益取决于代理池结构：在超过2,852个四基准子池中，当最大相关群体较弱时去相关有帮助，当最强时反而有害，且我们未找到无需标签的统计量来区分这两种情况。一旦引入标签，局面迅速改变：仅20个标注问题即可选出最优代理，其准确性高于我们测试的所有聚合器，在MMLU、ARC和TruthfulQA上表现更优。

summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a key component of language model post-training, enabling effective task adaptation and serving as an important foundation for subsequent reinforcement learning. Recent methods seek to improve SFT by introducing token-level weights into the training objective, where these weights are typically derived from a model's output distribution at each token position. To better understand how such weighting schemes affect SFT, we analyze their optimization objectives and theoretically characterize the target distributions they induce. Our analysis shows that dynamic weighting methods, such as Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT), induce a heavily sharpened distribution, whereas static weighting methods fit a target distribution proportional to the product of the data distribution and a frozen prior. These findings suggest that static weighting provides a more stable training target, while its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the prior distribution. Building on this observation, we propose Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning (SPFT), which uses a frozen copy of the initial model conditioned on privileged information (such as ground truth for mathematical questions) as a prior to provide guidance for token-level weighting during fine-tuning. Through a Bayesian decomposition, we further show that SPFT reweights the standard static prior according to how informative each target token is for predicting the ground-truth outcome, thereby assigning larger weights to more predictive tokens. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that SPFT improves over standard SFT and other baselines across the main settings.
title: Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning
title_translated: 自特权微调
summary_translated: 监督微调（SFT）是语言模型后训练的关键组成部分，能够实现有效的任务适配，并为后续强化学习奠定重要基础。近期方法通过在训练目标中引入逐标记权重来改进SFT，这些权重通常由模型在每个标记位置的输出分布得出。为了更好地理解此类加权策略对SFT的影响，我们分析了它们的优化目标，并理论刻画了其所诱导的目标分布。分析表明，动态加权方法（如动态微调DFT）会诱导出高度尖锐的分布，而静态加权方法则拟合与数据分布和固定先验乘积成比例的目标分布。这些发现表明，静态加权提供了更稳定的训练目标，但其有效性关键取决于先验分布的质量。基于此观察，我们提出自特权微调（SPFT），利用初始模型的一个冻结副本，结合特权信息（如数学问题的真值）作为先验，以指导微调过程中的逐标记加权。通过贝叶斯分解，我们进一步证明SPFT根据每个目标标记对预测真值结果的预测能力重新加权标准静态先验，从而为更具预测性的标记分配更大的权重。在数学推理和代码生成任务上的实验表明，SPFT在主要设置下优于标准SFT及其他基线方法。

summary: While conversational recommendation systems provide a more natural user interface, they face the challenge of progressively discovering a user's needs before they can recommend an item that satisfies them. To evaluate the ability of AI agents at this elicitation process, we introduce $τ$-Rec-Books, a benchmark that holds each user request fixed while varying only when the user reveals their requirements: all at the start (volunteer), one at the start and the rest when asked (mixed), or some never (hidden). A hidden requirement can be found only by proposing books and inferring it from the user's accept or reject verdicts. We generate 450 tasks over a catalog of 20,000 books from Wikidata, develop a rule-based simulated user to answer the agent, and score recommendations against catalog metadata without an LLM judge. Across four agents and two search interfaces, success rates fall for every agent and interface, on average from 0.975 (volunteer) to 0.756 (mixed) and 0.283 (hidden). Mixed tasks fail mainly because agents do not ask, and when told to ask, every agent reaches at least 0.931. On hidden tasks, most failures come from agents recommending a book they never proposed to the user. When told to propose first, agents only match a simple baseline that proposes popular books, and stay well below one that uses rejection to rule out possible requirements. We release the catalog pipeline, task generator, simulated user, validators, reference agents, and all agent traces at https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec/tree/main/data/tracks/books-wikidata-v2.
title: $τ$-Rec-Books: A Disclosure-Controlled Benchmark for Requirement Elicitation in Agentic Recommender Systems

title_translated: $τ$-Rec-Books：面向智能体推荐系统需求获取的披露控制基准
summary_translated: 虽然对话式推荐系统提供了更自然的用户界面，但面临在推荐满足用户需求的项目前逐步发现用户需求的挑战。为评估AI代理在此需求获取过程中的能力，我们引入$τ$-Rec-Books基准，该基准固定用户请求，仅变化用户揭示需求的时间点：全部在开始时（自愿）、开始时部分揭示其余待询问（混合）、或部分始终隐藏。隐藏需求只能通过提议书籍并根据用户的接受或拒绝判断来推断。我们在Wikidata的20,000本书籍目录中生成450个任务，开发基于规则的模拟用户响应代理，并基于目录元数据评分推荐结果，无需LLM裁判。在四个代理和两种搜索界面下，成功率普遍下降：平均从自愿情形的0.975降至混合情形的0.756和隐藏情形的0.283。混合任务失败主要因代理未提问；当被要求提问时，所有代理成功率均达0.931以上。在隐藏任务中，大多数失败源于代理推荐了从未向用户提出的书籍。当被要求先提议时，代理仅达到仅提议热门书籍的简单基线水平，远低于利用拒绝反馈排除可能需求的策略。我们已公开发布目录流水线、任务生成器、模拟用户、验证器、参考代理及所有代理轨迹，地址为https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec/tree/main/data/tracks/books-wikidata-v2。

summary: Agile Earth observation satellites must coordinate imaging tasks within limited observation windows, while accounting for attitude maneuvering and onboard energy constraints. Competition among observation opportunities makes scheduling performance sensitive to the heuristic rules used for task selection. This letter proposes a large language model (LLM)-assisted adaptive heuristic search method for agile Earth observation satellite scheduling. The LLM generates an initial heuristic rule according to the characteristics of the scheduling instance. During the subsequent ant colony search, search performance and scheduling information are fed back to the LLM to refine the heuristic rule. The proposed modifications are evaluated through paired solution constructions before being incorporated into the search process. A unified scheduling procedure determines task selection, satellite assignment, and observation timing under the operational constraints. Experiments on six scheduling scenarios involving 50--200 imaging tasks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 4.3\%--9.6\% higher mean observation benefit than the strongest baseline.
title: Large Language Model-Assisted Adaptive Heuristic Search for Agile Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling

title_translated: 大语言模型辅助的自适应启发式搜索在敏捷地球观测卫星调度中的应用
summary_translated: 敏捷地球观测卫星必须在有限的观测窗口内协调成像任务，同时考虑姿态机动和星载能源约束。观测机会之间的竞争使得调度性能对任务选择所用启发式规则极为敏感。本文提出一种大语言模型（LLM）辅助的自适应启发式搜索方法，用于敏捷地球观测卫星调度。LLM根据调度实例特征生成初始启发式规则；在随后的蚁群搜索过程中，将搜索性能和调度信息反馈给LLM以优化启发式规则。所提修改通过成对解构造评估后再融入搜索过程。统一调度流程在操作约束下确定任务选择、卫星分配和观测时间。在包含50–200个成像任务的六个调度场景实验中，所提方法相比最强基线实现了4.3%–9.6%更高的平均观测收益。

summary: Among 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints (20/38) contain reachable input embeddings with norms below $10^{-6}$, compared with 0% of weight-tied models. Such near-zero rows can arise during pretraining when unseen rare or template tokens receive zero input gradients while AdamW weight decay shrinks untied embeddings. In tested Transformer configurations, non-initial positions or a BOS token prevent this failure mode. In gated sequence models (Mamba, Gated DeltaNet, xLSTM), a near-zero token can amplify input-embedding gradients by more than 30 orders of magnitude (up to 35). At zero input, current-token readout factors (SiLU gates or linear queries) vanish, suppressing historical-state readout. Residual RMS values can then fall below the square root of the RMSNorm floor across consecutive layers, causing Pre-RMSNorm to amplify backward gradients by up to $10^3$ per layer. When a gradient entry exceeds $1.84 \times 10^{19}$, FP32 global-norm clipping in PyTorch, Hugging Face Trainer, and FSDP2 can overflow to infinity and zero the current batch's gradients. In Telugu continual pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, this discards updates on approximately 20% of steps and leaves triggered rows frozen. We propose two remedies. For released checkpoints, GroupClip decouples input-embedding clipping using a 64-bit or rescaled norm; its rescaled implementation eliminates update loss and heals triggered rows in one step with negligible measured end-to-end overhead. summary: Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. summary: LLM agents increasingly act on information retrieved from public sources they treat as credible, which turns a manipulated recommendation into a transaction, a dependency, or a decision with physical consequences. A single fabricated hazard, written as an ordinary review, leads the agent to disqualify the legitimate options and select the attacker's target by its own reasoning, with no command for a detector to recognize. We call this voluntary servitude. These payloads steer agents about as often as instruction injection (60.4% vs. 66.0%), and deployed injection detectors score them as benign, so behind a filter they are 1.7-4.4x more effective. summary: A text-to-SQL answer can run, return a plausible number and still compute something other than what the analyst meant. Standard benchmarks cannot detect this, because they score each question against a single reference interpretation. We introduce SpecBridge, which tests such a choice by varying it alone: it poses three otherwise identical requests, one leaving the choice open and one per interpretation, and scores each answer by running it. The databases are real, and the choices are ones that made models fail on existing benchmarks. On 204 hand-validated tests, four language models usually compute each interpretation when asked for it, yet for the open request return both in only 15-58% of the tests where they can, often without mentioning the choice. The gap lies in reporting, not in computing. Benchmarks even penalize the alternative: on BIRD questions where such a choice changes the answer, over two in five of the answers marked wrong are right under the other interpretation. Because the gap lies in reporting, a system can narrow it without a stronger model: it first decides whether a request leaves a choice open, then answers each interpretation in its own call. On our tests and on AMBROSIA, an existing benchmark of ambiguous questions, this approach raises the share of open requests that get every interpretation by 29-63 points over the single answer that production assistants give, without lowering precision on clear requests. It also needs fewer user turns than asking a clarifying question.
title: Text-to-SQL Models Make Choices Without Saying So

summary: We introduce a training-free sparse attention method that builds a prompt-specific key index to accelerate both prefill and decoding. Queries that select the same block are processed together, so prefill stays fast even though each query chooses its own blocks. Large blocks make centroid scoring and this grouped processing cheap, so each query can attend to more tokens in the same time. Larger blocks with a larger token budget can thus be both faster and more accurate on long-context tasks than smaller blocks with a smaller budget. summary: Inoculation prompting is a method to reduce undesired behaviours such as reward hacking in frontier models. NIP outperforms other inoculation methods, and performs competitively with gradient routing despite being simpler. It also works on reward hacking, but fails on sycophancy and harassment. Using control tokens and analyses of activations, we identify the mechanism for this as NIP hiding the harmful behaviour behind an unreachable region of model inputs, rather than deleting it. More broadly, our work suggests that neologisms can be a powerful way to carve out and shape access to behaviours that are undesired or harmful.

summary: Looped transformers apply a shared block several times per token to improve accuracy without adding parameters. For models such as Ouro that keep a separate key-value (KV) cache per loop, cache memory limits the batch size that amortizes repeated weight reads. Uniform-bit quantization and fixed rules per loop do not allocate precision according to each layer's sensitivity in each loop. Measurements on Ouro show that quantization sensitivity varies across (loop, layer) cells, and the sum of individual cell damages approximates the overall output damage. Sharing damage also varies by cell, with later loops generally tolerating sharing better. Skipping low-attention values to save reads produces errors that compound across loops. LoopKV uses a one-time offline profile to choose 4-bit storage, 2-bit storage or reuse of the final loop's KV for each cell. The planner minimizes reads under budgets for predicted damage and storage. During decoding, each loop reads the high 2 bits of each 4-bit value and fetches the low bits only where its own attention weights require 4-bit precision. A single fused kernel in vLLM executes the plan. Serving Ouro-1.4B on one RTX PRO 6000, the memory-optimized LoopKV-M plan stores 35% less KV than uniform 4-bit quantization (KIVI-4) on the same fused kernel and CUDA graph. It sustains 1.7-2.2x KIVI-4's goodput under a latency service-level objective with a 16K-token maximum length. None of its averages on six public benchmarks falls significantly below BF16's.

summary: Routing benchmarks often judge a router against a hindsight oracle that counts a query as solved whenever any model's recorded answer is correct, but under stochastic decoding that oracle mixes two different objects: the clairvoyant ceiling of committing to one model per query and the premium of calling several models and keeping any correct answer. A companion study measured this premium at 3.5 percentage points (pp) for 11 small open models on MATH-500; how large it is once current reasoning models enter the pool was unknown. We measure it with a fixed-protocol, pre-committed generation on a single NVIDIA B300: all 500 MATH-500 problems, 30 seeded samples per problem, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 9B v2 and Nemotron Super 49B v1.5 (a NAS derivative of the same 70B) under vendor sampling, a 65,536-token cap, a pinned Math-Verify scorer, and an append-only attempt ledger, for 45,000 scored responses. The two reasoning models both reach 96.1% accuracy against 76.2% for the 70B baseline. The empirical product-coupling premium is 0.215-0.588 pp across all two- and three-model pools; the empirical plug-in selection headroom over always calling Nano is 1.27 pp; and resampling Nano three times gives practically the same empirical any-correct rate as calling all three models once. Only 31 responses reached the cap, 25 of them with exactly periodic tails, yet the capped responses account for up to 60.2% of a model's output-length-squared proxy, and long generations made a fourth planned model, Llama-3.1-8B, too slow to finish. The premium is far below the companion's 3.5 pp, but models, pool size and protocol changed together; an oracle gap should therefore be reported with the pool, the protocol, the samples per cell and the decoding budget that produced it.
title: When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing

summary: Real-world problems span diverse domains, including program synthesis, symbolic reasoning, planning, and optimization, and often require fundamentally different solution paradigms. A central challenge for LLM-based reasoning is twofold: identifying an appropriate problem-solving approach and formulating it correctly. In this paper, we propose AlgoPilot, a cross-paradigm reasoning framework that enables adaptive selection of the solving approaches and structured problem formulation prior to execution. The AlgoPilot framework contains three components: 1) a SteerLM, trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), that adaptively selects the solving strategy (paradigm and modes) based on input problems, 2) the corresponding expert GuideLM, trained via SFT, that generates structured formulation guidance tailored to the selected strategy, and 3) an ExecutionLM that generates solutions conditioned on both the selected strategy and its formulation. Unlike prompting-based methods that rely on fixed reasoning templates, our approach learns to adaptively choose and structure problem-solving strategies based on the input. We build AlgoPilot on Qwen3-8B and evaluate across 5 problem categories and 13 benchmarks with 66 unique domains, comparing against both the latest similarly scaled small models and large LLMs. AlgoPilot significantly improves average accuracy for the same model from 38.4% to 72.9%, outperforming the best large LLM prompting baseline GLM-5 by 11.7%. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component. Notably, we show that the learned steering and formulation modules can transfer across execution models, suggesting their potential to improve other LLMs. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/algopilot.

summary: LLM agents struggle to automate complex enterprise procedures because static, pre-built harness cannot capture proprietary policies, undocumented behaviors, or state-dependent recovery paths that surface only during execution. Procedural memory accrued from agent experience offers a training-free path to closing this gap -- yet unlike episodic records or semantic facts, it must consolidate repeated successes and diagnosed failures into reusable actions and recovery strategies. We introduce WASP-Mem (Wiki-based Agent-Synthesized Procedural Memory), a nimble but effective method that distills execution traces and feedback into persistent, interlinked wiki pages, enabling continual agent learning. On TheAgentCompany benchmark, WASP-Mem raises the checkpoint pass rate by 4.6-6.1% over the strongest baseline we compared across three models while requiring 57-61% less storage. We further present a systematic controlled study spanning consolidation method, feedback type, trace ingestion scope, and refinement rounds. Our results reveal that prescriptive knowledge organization such as human defined schemas and explicit deduplication rules hurts performance rather than closing the procedural-knowledge gap. In contrast, human diagnosis converts failed traces into corrective knowledge and drives sustained improvement: a single round of human diagnosis outperforms four rounds of self-judgment by 7.0-10.9%. These findings point to a simple division of labor: let agents organize procedural memory, and invest human effort where it matters most -- diagnosis.
title: WASP-Mem: Let Agent Organize Procedural Memory. Human Spend Effort on Diagnosis

summary: Large language models (LLMs) read company news at scale, and backtests suggest that their readings predict stock returns. We ask how much of that predictability survives a test that rules out look-ahead, memorization and selection. We propose OLIVIA, a protocol for such tests: point-in-time inputs with company identities masked, selection on validation data only, an analysis plan frozen by cryptographic hash, and a test period unblinded once through a logged lock. We apply it to AI decision models, non-generative language models that return probabilities for typed questions, reading news about S&P 500 stocks: an open-weights model we fine-tuned on 2024-2025 data, three commercial models and standard baselines. The fine-tuned model's signal replicated on two validation quarters (daily information coefficients 0.055 and 0.065) but fell to 0.020 (t = 1.7) on the blinded January-July 2026 test. The commercial models' readings line up with the overnight move to the open (information coefficient 0.074 to 0.077) but not with the move after it, so the news is priced by the time a trader can act on it at the open. No model can tell over- from under-reaction, and no pre-registered strategy survives costs and a deflated Sharpe ratio. Commercial models identify masked companies in 62% to 74% of cases against a 28% baseline: masking hides names, not companies. The market reads the news first.
title: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market

summary: Assistive systems typically tell users everything, often spending time and attention on what a user already knows, leaving less for what happens next. People, on the other hand, leave out what they expect the listener can supply. Can people use their prior knowledge to understand an incomplete message when the speaker is a machine though? We studied this pragmatic comprehension in a monitoring task controlling users' prior knowledge and the available time to detect critical situations. In a preregistered study (N=114), we compared a pragmatic planner that reasons over a model of the listener's knowledge to decide what to say, when, and how explicitly, with a baseline specifying problems fully in onset order. Participants resolved underspecified alerts almost as reliably as fully specified ones and sooner, detected more problems, and rated the pragmatic assistant helpful more often, with no increase in reported mental demand. Our findings show that people can recover what the system left implicit and that pragmatic communication can support effective assistance under the constraints of a changing world.
title: Must AI Spell It Out? Pragmatic Comprehension of Alerts in a Time-Critical Task

summary: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) let one base model serve many fine-tuned variants: multi-tenant engines keep a single copy of the base and batch the requests of many tenants, each with its own adapter. As base models move to 8-bit (FP8) and 4-bit formats, their general matrix multiplications (GEMMs) become cheaper, but the adapters do not: engines run them as separate small GPU kernels beside the GEMM, whose latency takes a growing share of every decoding step. An adapter projects its input down to a low rank and back up, and our key observation is that the GEMM needs the down-projection only in its epilogue, the final stage in which it writes its output. EpiLoRA, a plugin for the vLLM engine, therefore launches the down-projection first and the low-precision GEMM as a dependent kernel that streams its weights meanwhile and adds every tenant's up-projection in its epilogue. On NVIDIA Hopper GPUs, EpiLoRA decodes for a single adapter with up to 24% lower time per token than vLLM's fastest configuration, and faster than SGLang and TensorRT-LLM; with many tenants, its adapter kernels deliver more throughput than vLLM's on most GPU-model pairs we tested. The same low-precision base also trains: a LoRA reinforcement-learning trainer that computes on the engine's FP8 weights needs no 16-bit copy, so a 27B model trains on one 48 GB GPU, and an engine that then keeps activations in 16 bits removes most of the remaining mismatch between the model generating training data and the one trained.
title: EpiLoRA: Fusing Many LoRA Adapters into Low-Precision GEMMs for Serving and RL

summary: Language models serve as the reasoning core of agents for chemistry and materials science, where they must interpret molecular structure before planning syntheses or proposing materials. Yet their outputs show only what they say, not what they know. Given a prompt such as ``The primary functional group in 1-Fluorobutane (CCCCF) is'', a small general-purpose model may answer ``the alkyne group'' instead of an alkyl fluoride. The output alone cannot tell whether the model failed to recognize the fluorine or recognized it and failed to say so. We address this by reading the internal representations of five open-source models on prompts covering 92 molecules and 20 functional groups. Even without chemistry training, the models organize functional groups by chemical family, and they encode chemical differences as consistent directions. The shift from thioether ($\mathrm{R{-}S{-}R'}$) to thiol ($\mathrm{R{-}SH}$), added to ether ($\mathrm{R{-}O{-}R'}$), lands nearest alcohol ($\mathrm{R{-}OH}$). This structure emerges abruptly in the middle layers, where representations shift from tracking the wording of the prompt to tracking the functional group. The base model names the correct functional group in only 58.5\% of prompts, the lowest of the five, yet it encodes functional-group families and preserves chemically meaningful patterns. Its errors are mostly failures to answer rather than wrong answers. Functional-group knowledge is structured in the model before it is spoken. Chemistry fine-tuning reorganizes it, making functional groups rather than prompt wording dominate the representation. These results suggest that evaluating chemical language models through outputs alone can underestimate the chemical information they encode. Representation analysis can distinguish a lack of knowledge from a failure to express it, which matters when choosing or adapting models for chemical agents.
title: Functional-Group Knowledge Is Structured in Language Models Before It Is Spoken

summary: Language models often spread a concept across many internal dimensions, making their features difficult to interpret. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) recover clearer features after training. We ask whether models can instead learn interpretable output coordinates directly. We introduce Mixture of Wide Experts (MoWE), a sparse feed-forward layer in which selected experts read the full representation but write to fixed, disjoint output coordinates. On a controlled task with known hidden causes, this design preserves predictive performance while localizing causes more clearly than dense and standard mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.   At approximately matched compute, we train two 19-layer runs of each architecture for 10 billion tokens. MoWE achieves evaluation cross-entropy 2.417 versus 2.452 for dense, while standard MoE reaches 2.22.   We measure native-coordinate readability by asking a language-model judge to describe each coordinate from passages where it is strongly active and test that description on new passages. Correcting for descriptions that also fit other coordinates gives a specificity score of 0.523 for MoWE, 0.375 for dense, and 0.268 for standard MoE. TopK SAEs trained on the same FFN updates score 0.489 for dense and 0.556 for MoWE, making native MoWE comparable to the dense SAE.   In the first case study, we identify a four-coordinate causal path supporting the model's prediction of degrees after the prompt A right angle is 90. We then copy seven angle-related coordinate values into the model as it processes A rectangle has four, changing its next-token prediction from sides to degrees. In the second, one fixed coordinate set detects hazardous requests and another steers the next token toward refusal. These examples show that MoWE combines sparse conditional computation with coordinates that can be identified and reused directly.
title: Mixture of Wide Experts: Sparse Routing for Interpretable Native Coordinates
